name: standing-pvc-pec-mobilization
instructions:
1. Setup in a standing position with a PVC pipe in both hands while utilizing a very wide grip.
2. Place your top hand on top of the PVC pipe.
3. Using your bottom hand, push the PVC pipe up and back into the palm of your top hand while keeping your shoulders square.
4. Press back until your get a significant stretch in the pec of the arm overhead.
5. Return back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
